gloss: each going their own way; scattered every which way

definitions.gloss: each going their own way; scattered in every direction
definitions.explanation: Describes people or things acting or moving individually in different directions, with no coordination. Often emphasizes a lack of unity or organization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧てんでんばらばらだ。
examples.english: Everyone's opinions are all over the place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧てんでんばらばら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: The family went out each in a different direction.

examples.japanese: {震災後|しんさいご}、⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧てんでんばらばら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}した→避難する：26827_hinansuru⟧。
examples.english: After the earthquake, the villagers fled in every direction to different places.

notes:
Combines ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧んでん (each one, on one's own) with ⟦ばらばら→ばらばら：05165_barabara⟧ (scattered). The てんでん part is an emphatic colloquial form of ⟦{各々|おのおの}→各々：00334_onoono⟧/⟦{各自|かくじ}→各自：00157_kakuji⟧. Strongly emphasizes lack of coordination.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- As a na-adjective: てんでんばらばらだ / てんでんばらばらな + noun
- Adverbially: てんでんばらばら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ばらばら→ばらばら：05165_barabara⟧: scattered; in pieces — neutral and broader; てんでんばらばら adds emphasis on individuality
- ⟦{各自|かくじ}→各自：00157_kakuji⟧: each individually — more formal; lacks the chaotic connotation
